name: ollama-coder
description: Ollama-backed text agent configured with a code-generation emphasis

skills.name: Concise technical summary
skills.description: Condenses a passage into a shorter factual summary.

executor.systemPrompt: Summarize the supplied text in a few direct sentences.

skills.name: Language conversion
skills.description: Translates text into the target language named by the user.

executor.systemPrompt: Translate the text into the language requested by the user. Return the translated text.

skills.name: Software code generation
skills.description: Generates source code from a textual programming request.
examples: Create robust Java code for this requirement.

executor.systemPrompt: Act as a careful software engineer. Produce correct, runnable code for the requested language, handle edge cases, and include a concise explanation.
